purpose: Map the v85 child-assistance context-loss demand/friction miss into permanent regressions in the SAME Stödassistenten learning system.

mappings.product_miss: The existing disability-home-support natural-language route drops child/adult subject context from its handoff and therefore defaults the focused assistance result to the adult Försäkringskassan source; its older professional guard also misses 'jobbar med barn och personlig assistans'.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Reuse the existing disability_home_support route. Preserve only coarse support_for=child|adult when already established; use the matching current Försäkringskassan primary source; show both child and adult primary-source choices when subject is unknown instead of silently assuming adult; fail closed for professional/research wording; keep sv/ar/fa parity.
mappings.truth_boundary: support_for is routing context only, never eligibility evidence. Child and adult canonical assistance truth remain separately source-bound and NEEDS_REVIEW where applicable. No raw story, diagnosis, exact age, name, personnummer or address may be serialized in the handoff or feedback.
